description: Comment "Messages" and I'll send you the full setup guide 👇 You can now connect ChatGPT directly to your Apple Messages and it can actually read and send texts for you. OpenAI just gave ChatGPT direct access to your Apple Messages and it's completely free on every plan. Here's how to set it up in 30 seconds: Open the ChatGPT desktop app on your Mac → choose Work Go to Plugins → search "Messages" → choose Apple Messages Click Install Plugin Now start a chat with App Messages and say things like: "Find the address my landlord texted me last month." It pulls it up in 2 seconds. Or say: "Reply back to my mom and tell her I'll be at lunch on Sunday." It drafts the text and sends it as soon as you approve it. I even had it build a dashboard ranking the top people I've ever messaged and how many messages we've exchanged. The results were honestly insane. #chatgpt #ai #applemessages #aitools #productivity
